title: The Best Moments From KCON LA 2026 (So Far)
summary: Day two delivered delightful covers of Justin Timberlake, One Direction, BLACKPINK and ATEEZ songs as ZEROBASEONE headlined the concert.
body: Los Angeles officially belongs to K-pop this weekend with KCON LA 2026, but the city has been deep in K-pop all week. This year’s KCON festival officially opened Friday (Aug. 14) at the Los Angeles Convention Center and Crypto.com Arena. Under the theme “Walk in SOUL CITY,” a play on the South Korean capital, festival producer CJ ENM is stretching 2026’s convention across K-pop, K-beauty, K-food and K-story programming, including the first-ever Olive Young Festa K-Beauty Playground, which boasts 55 different Korean brands. But by the time doors opened on day one, the city had already been running on K-pop culture for days. HYBE America started things Wednesday with an industry party under the theme of “K-Pop’s Biggest Weekend.” The U.S. branch of the Korean-entertainment giant had a red carpet, photo booths, cotton candy machines and members of its global roster — boy bands &TEAM and Santos Bravos, as well as their pre-debut girl group SAINT SATINE — alongside Eric Nam, Ji-young Yoo and other cast members from K-Pop: The Debut , the Paramount and HYBE America film due in theaters in February 2027. title: Olivia Dean at MSG: The 5 Best Moments From the Second of Her Four Sold-Out Shows
summary: The English singer-songwriter proves she's at the peak of her powers.
body: “This album has completely changed my life” may sound like a familiar sentiment that any artist might share during a new album cycle, but for Olivia Dean and her second LP The Art of Loving , it’s practically an understatement. Midway through her Saturday (Aug. 15) night show in New York City, the English singer-songwriter paused to reflect on a transformative period that saw her go from opening for Sabrina Carpenter’s Short n’ Sweet Tour, which rolled into Madison Square Garden in fall 2025, to selling out four nights as the headliner at the same venue just 10 months later. “That was my first time in an arena,” Dean shared of opening for Sab. “This is crazy. Now we’re doing our own four shows here.” Since then, Dean won four BRIT Awards, was crowned best new artist at the 2026 Grammys and notched two top 5 hits on the Billboard Hot 100, with the unstoppable “Man I Need” and the effortlessly charming “So Easy (To Fall In Love).” After playing MSG on Friday (Aug. 14) night (during which she introduced “Slowly” to the setlist), Dean admitted that she felt more at ease during Saturday’s show. “We got the nervous one out of the way,” she smiled. “Now we relax.” Ten years ago, it…

title: Stray Kids’ Latest Becomes Milestone 25th K-pop Album to Top Billboard 200: Full List
summary: BTS was the first K-pop act to top the all-genre chart; BLACKPINK was the first female K-pop act to do so.
body: Stray Kids’ This & That puts K-pop back in a familiar spot — No. 1 on the all-genre Billboard 200 chart. The EP is the 25th album or EP by a K-pop act to reach No. 1 on Billboard’s flagship albums chart in just over eight years. The first was BTS’ Love Yourself: Tear in June 2018. Stray Kids  has amassed nine No. 1 titles on the Billboard 200, which puts them out front among K-pop acts.  BTS is second, with seven No. 1 titles.  ATEEZ  is next in line with three No. 1s.  SuperM ,  BLACKPINK ,  TOMORROW X TOGETHER ,  NewJeans  and  TWICE  have all notched one No. 1 to date. In addition, one multi-artist K-pop soundtrack, KPop Demon Hunters , has reached No. 1. For all their success on the Billboard 200, Stray Kids have yet to crack the top 40 on the Billboard Hot 100. Their highest-charting single on that chart, “Chk Chk Boom,” debuted and peaked at No. 49 in August 2024.
